description: This file defines the 'ProductReviewService' interface, which extends a generic service interface and declares methods related to handling product reviews, such as retrieving reviews by customer, product, product with language, and by both product and customer.

classes.name: ProductReviewService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService specifically for ProductReview entities, providing methods to retrieve reviews based on customer, product, language, and IDs.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews for a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews for a specific product and language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a product review associated with a specific product ID and customer ID.
